pages.title: Digital Service Information Study
pages.body:
This fictional study asks about a hypothetical municipal program. It takes approximately five minutes.

Preview mode does not save data externally.

pages.title: Participant information and consent
pages.body: Participation is voluntary. This is fictional placeholder consent for a golden-reference preview and is not an approved consent form.

questions.label: Do you consent to participate in this study?
What is your age in years?

pages.title: Your current views
pages.body: The program described later in the study is fictional.

questions.label: Before seeing details, how much would you support a city program that helps residents use online public services?
Before today, how familiar were you with municipal digital-assistance programs?

pages.title: Municipal Digital Help Desk
pages.body: The city is considering a program with telephone and in-person help for residents using online public services. The proposal would operate at three libraries, five days per week, with an estimated annual budget of $600,000.

pages.title: Making Online Public Services Easier
pages.body: The city is considering a program with telephone and in-person help so residents can complete online public services more easily and avoid unnecessary trips. The proposal would operate at three libraries, five days per week, with an estimated annual budget of $600,000.

pages.title: Questions about the description
pages.body: Please answer based on the description you saw.

questions.label: At how many libraries would the proposed program operate?
How strongly did the description emphasize practical benefits to residents?
For data-quality purposes, please select ‘Somewhat agree.’

pages.title: Your opinion
pages.body: Tell us what you think about the proposed program.

questions.label: After reading the description, how much do you support the proposed program?
Please indicate your agreement with each statement.

rows.label: The program would be useful to residents.
The program would make online services easier to access.

questions.label: What is the main reason you do not support the proposed program?
Is there anything else you would like the research team to know?

pages.title: About you
pages.body: You may choose ‘Prefer not to answer’ where offered.

questions.label: What is the highest level of education you have completed?
questions.placeholder: Choose one or prefer not to answer

questions.label: How do you describe your gender?
How would you like to describe your gender?

pages.title: Before submitting
pages.body: Choose whether to submit or withdraw. Preview mode will not contact an external service.

questions.label: What would you like to do?
Should the research team receive a request to delete responses already collected in this session?

pages.title: Thank you
pages.body: Your preview responses reached the completion outcome. No production redirect was performed.

pages.title: You are not eligible
pages.body: This fixture is limited to adults. No research questions beyond consent and eligibility were collected.

pages.title: Participation declined
pages.body: No research responses were collected. Preview mode suppresses the panel return route.

pages.title: Participation ended
pages.body: The preview reached the withdrawal outcome. No external deletion request was sent.

pages.title: We could not continue
pages.body: This terminal page allows researchers to inspect the technical-error experience.
